snippet.title: Terrifier The ARTcade Game | Release Date + Main Theme Reveal
snippet.description:
🎪 Have the Last Laugh, Terrifier: The ARTcade Game launches November 21st for PC, PS5, NSW and Xbox Series! 💀
Step into the blood-soaked shoes of Art the Clown in this brutal 2D retro-inspired beat ‘em up where chaos, carnage, and dark humor collide. Hack, slash, and shut down movie sets recreating your crimes, by any means necessary.

🩸 First revealed during the Indie Horror Showcase, this trailer not only confirms the release date but also debuts the game’s haunting main theme by Cody Carpenter, son of horror legend John Carpenter, courtesy of Scarlet Moon.

⚔️ Features to Die For:
🎨 Gorgeous pixel art and fluid, gory animations
👥 Local co-op with up to 4 players, team up or turn on each other
🔪 Bloody arsenal: chainsaws, cleavers, and more
🏙️ Multiple stages and brutal boss battles
🎶 Chiptune soundtrack inspired by the golden arcade era
💥 Six game modes with unique challenges and over-the-top finishers

📦 Pre-order physical Edition: https://videogamesplus.ca/collections/terrifier-the-videogame
⚫ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130400/Terrifier_The_ARTcade_Game/
🔵 PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012787/
🔴 Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/terrifier-the-artcade-game-switch/
🟢Soon Xbox Series Link
🕹️ Launches November 21st, the mayhem begins soon!
